extension.description.note: The extension description in the browser store and extension list.
extension.description.en: Lets Imp know which page you are on and where things are on it. Talks only to Imp on this computer.
extension.description.es: Permite que Imp sepa en qué página estás y dónde está cada cosa. Habla solo con Imp en este equipo.
extension.description.zh-Hans: 让 Imp 知道你在看哪个页面，以及页面上的东西在哪里。只和这台电脑上的 Imp 通信。

extension.action_title.note: The tooltip of the toolbar button.

extension.status.checking.note: Connection status while the extension looks for Imp.

extension.status.connecting.note: Connection status while a connection attempt runs.

extension.status.connected.note: Connection status when Imp is reachable.

extension.status.connected_browser.note: Connection status when Imp is reachable, with the name of the browser.

extension.status.not_connected.note: Connection status when Imp cannot be reached.

extension.reconnect.note: Button that tries to reach Imp again.

extension.reconnect.help.note: Help for the button that tries to reach Imp again.
extension.reconnect.help.en: Looks for Imp again. Use it after you start Imp.
extension.reconnect.help.es: Vuelve a buscar a Imp. Úsalo después de abrir Imp.
extension.reconnect.help.zh-Hans: 重新寻找 Imp。启动 Imp 之后用它。

extension.back.note: Button that goes back to the first screen of the popup.

extension.help.note: Label of the small question mark button that opens a help tip.

extension.tab.untitled.note: Name of a page that has no title.

extension.tab.label.note: Accessible name of the box that shows the page you are on.

extension.tab.sees.note: Help for the page box when Imp can look inside the page.
extension.tab.sees.en: Imp can read this page and find things on it when it needs to.
extension.tab.sees.es: Imp puede leer esta página y encontrar cosas en ella cuando lo necesita.
extension.tab.sees.zh-Hans: Imp 需要时可以读这个页面，也能在上面找东西。

extension.tab.blind.note: Help for the page box when the browser keeps the page private.
extension.tab.blind.en: The browser keeps this page to itself. Imp only knows its address.
extension.tab.blind.es: El navegador no comparte esta página. Imp solo conoce su dirección.
extension.tab.blind.zh-Hans: 浏览器不让别人看这个页面。Imp 只知道它的地址。

extension.activity.title.note: Title of the list of what Imp just did in the browser.

extension.activity.help.note: Help for the list of what Imp just did.
extension.activity.help.en: When Imp reads a page or looks for something on one, it shows up here.
extension.activity.help.es: Cuando Imp lee una página o busca algo en ella, aparece aquí.
extension.activity.help.zh-Hans: Imp 读页面或在页面上找东西时，会显示在这里。

extension.activity.empty.note: Shown when Imp has done nothing yet.

extension.activity.see_all.note: Button that opens the whole list. The number is how many entries there are.

extension.activity.list_label.note: Accessible name of the full list.
extension.activity.list_label.es: Todo lo que Imp hizo hace poco
extension.activity.list_label.zh-Hans: Imp 最近做过的所有事

extension.activity.search.note: Placeholder of the search box over the full list.

extension.activity.search_label.note: Accessible name of the search box over the full list.
extension.activity.search_label.zh-Hans: 搜索 Imp 做过的事

extension.activity.no_match.note: Shown when the search finds nothing.

extension.activity.count_some.note: Count of the entries that match the search.

extension.activity.found.note: Start of a line: Imp found something on a page. The searched words follow.

extension.activity.looked_for.note: Start of a line: Imp looked for something on a page and did not find it. The searched words follow.

extension.activity.read.note: A line: Imp read a page.

extension.activity.read_failed.note: A line: Imp could not read a page.

extension.ago.now.note: How long ago something happened: just now.

extension.ago.seconds.note: How long ago: a number of seconds, as short as possible.

extension.ago.minutes.note: How long ago: a number of minutes, as short as possible.

extension.ago.hours.note: How long ago: a number of hours, as short as possible.

extension.offline.title.note: Title shown when Imp is not running.

extension.offline.body.note: Shown when Imp is not running: what to do.
extension.offline.body.en: Start Imp on this computer and this connects by itself.
extension.offline.body.es: Abre Imp en este equipo y esto se conecta solo.
extension.offline.body.zh-Hans: 在这台电脑上启动 Imp，这里会自动连上。

extension.private.note: Note that nothing leaves the computer.

extension.open.note: Button that opens the Imp app.

extension.open.help.note: Help for the button that opens the Imp app.
extension.open.help.en: Opens the Imp app. It starts Imp if it is not running.
extension.open.help.es: Abre la app de Imp. La inicia si no está abierta.
extension.open.help.zh-Hans: 打开 Imp 应用。如果它没在运行，就先启动它。

extension.imp.fallback.note: Accessible name of an Imp that has no name.

extension.imp.device_default.note: Name of the phone an Imp is on when it did not say which.

extension.imp.working.note: Accessible name of an Imp that is working.

extension.imp.working_away.note: Accessible name of an Imp that is working on another device.

extension.imp.asleep.note: Accessible name of an Imp that is asleep.

extension.imp.away.note: Accessible name of an Imp that is on another device.
